address: Rua Costa Pinto 17, Paço de Arcos, 2770-046, Portugal
bio: All it takes is crossing the threshold to see the beauty of this place, which may appear unassuming from the outside, but... surprises you with its rustic interior and hints of sophistication. Its name recalls the site’s history, as this 15th-century building was once a tax house. The menu is a celebration of traditional Portuguese cuisine, made with high quality ingredients and clearly defined flavours. Try starting with the fresh scallop accompanied by mango and prawn ceviche, continue with the tasty duck magret served with a tangerine sauce and vegetables, and finish with the delicate raspberry and mascarpone millefeuille. Don’t forget to book a table by the window to enjoy a splendid view of the Tagus, or sit on the pleasant terrace when the sun is out!...
